title: South Carolina Code of Laws Title 27, Chapter 40 - Residential Landlord and Tenant Act
source_id: S.C. Code Ann. tit. 27, ch. 40 (secs. 27-40-10 to 27-40-940)
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 27 chapter index (https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title27.php): title 'Title 27 - Property and Conveyances', chapter row 'CHAPTER 40 - RESIDENTIAL LANDLORD AND TENANT ACT' with no [REPEALED] marker; then fetched https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t27c040.php, whose heading reads 'CHAPTER 40 / Residential Landlord and Tenant Act', with Article 1 (General Provisions and Definitions), Article 3 (Landlord Obligations), Article 5 (Tenant Obligations), Article 7 (Remedies) and Article 9 (Retaliatory Conduct Prohibited; Miscellaneous), running from SECTION 27-40-10 to SECTION 27-40-940. Currency: current through the 2025 Session.
notes: South Carolina's enactment of the Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act: security deposits, habitability, rent, notice and eviction. General consumer protection is a different statute - Title 37, the South Carolina Consumer Protection Code (verified in force at https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title37.php, with ch. 37-1 General Provisions and Definitions, ch. 37-2 Credit Sales, ch. 37-5 Remedies and Penalties and ch. 37-6 Administration) - and manufactured-home tenancy is Title 27, Chapter 47; neither is listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
